title: Grateful Dead Live at Frost Amphitheatre on 1982-10-10
source: Matrix by Hunter Seamons using Final Cut Pro (FLAC24 > AIFF > Final Cut > AIFF CD tracking via Audacity (w/dither) > FLAC16 via xACT)

ai_review.summary: A superb Hunter Seamons matrix delivers crystal‑clear sound while the band burns through a smoking Cassidy jam, stellar Tennessee Jed and China/Rider.
ai_review.review: The matrix recording is praised as one of the best of the early Brent era—balanced, crisp and surprisingly immersive despite a slight boomy character that Seamons smooths out. The performance itself is high‑energy, highlighted by an epic Cassidy jam, inspired renditions of Tennessee Jed, Sugaree, China/Rider and a powerful Play‑in‑the‑Band stretch in the second set.

ai_rating.rationale: All seven reviews are overwhelmingly positive (six 5‑star, one 4‑star), emphasizing both excellent show performance and top‑tier matrix sound quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, balanced mix with good instrument separation; a bit boomy/thick but smoothed by Seamons' layering of audience thinness. Phil is audible (especially on Minglewood), Jerry’s vocals slightly ragged but present.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Smooth flow with a strong first set and an especially compelling second set; transitions praised, overall pacing tight.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Voice a little ragged but still inspired; leads the band strongly throughout.
band_member_comments.Phil: Usually buried in mixes of this year, but clearly heard here—especially on Minglewood.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent sounds inspired and well‑balanced in the mix.
